detail.text: I need to read the repository structure and AGENTS.md to understand the conventions, then create a plan for building the link shortener application.

Now I have a good understanding of the repository structure. Let me create a plan for building the link shortener application. The spec requires:

1. Accounts (signup, login, logout with sessions)
2. Links (create, list, delete, redirect with click counting)
3. Stats (per-link clicks per day for 30 days)
4. QR code generation
5. Rate limits
6. SQLite storage with migrations
7. Frontend pages
8. Acceptance tests

I need to split this into cards following the conventions:
- One foundation card (layout, API contract, schema, one end-to-end test)
- Feature cards (each about 10 files max)
- One integration card (acceptance tests)

Let me design the plan:

```json
{
  "summary": "Build a link shortener with Go API and TypeScript SPA. Foundation establishes store interface, session handling, and server wiring. Feature cards add auth, links, stats/QR, rate limiting, and frontend pages. Integration card runs acceptance tests A1-A9.",
  "cards": [
    {
      "key": "foundation",
      "role": "foundation",
      "title": "Store interface, schema, session middleware, server wiring",
      "brief": "Establish the app's contracts: `internal/store.Store` interface with methods CreateUser, GetUserByEmail, CreateSession, GetSession, DeleteSession, CreateLink, GetLinkBySlug, ListLinksByUser, DeleteLink, RecordClick, GetClickStats; SQLite implementation in `internal/sqlite` using modernc.org/sqlite; migrations embedded via `//go:embed`; session middleware in `internal/server` extracting user from HttpOnly cookie; `server.New` wires store and middleware. One end-to-end test: POST /api/signup creates user, GET /healthz returns ok. All feature cards import `internal/server.New` and use the Store interface.",
      "directories": ["internal/store", "internal/sqlite", "internal/server", "migrations"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestHealthz in internal/server: GET /healthz returns 200 with status ok"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "auth",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Signup, login, logout endpoints with bcrypt and sessions",
      "brief": "Implement POST /api/signup (email, password >=10 chars, bcrypt hash), POST /api/login (sets HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie), POST /api/logout (deletes session), GET /api/me (returns current user or 401). Use store.CreateUser, GetUserByEmail, CreateSession, GetSession, DeleteSession. Unit tests in internal/server for each endpoint. Password validation rejects <10 chars with 400.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignup in internal/server: valid signup returns 201", "TestLogin in internal/server: valid login sets cookie", "TestMe in internal/server: authenticated GET /api/me returns user"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "links",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Create, list, delete links and redirect with click counting",
      "brief": "POST /api/links (URL http/https <=2048 chars, optional slug [a-z0-9-]{3,32}, else 7 random chars; 409 on duplicate slug; 400 on bad scheme). GET /api/links lists user's links with click counts. DELETE /api/links/<slug> deletes own link (404 if not owner). GET /<slug> redirects 302 to target, records click (total and per UTC day). Unknown slug returns 404. Uses store.CreateLink, GetLinkBySlug, ListLinksByUser, DeleteLink, RecordClick.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestCreateLink in internal/server: valid URL returns 201 with slug", "TestRedirect in internal/server: GET /<slug> returns 302 with Location header"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "stats-qr",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Per-link stats and QR code endpoint",
      "brief": "GET /api/links/<slug>/stats returns clicks per day for last 30 days (array of {date, count}). GET /api/links/<slug>/qr returns PNG of short URL (use skip2/go-qrcode or similar pure-Go library). Both require ownership (404 otherwise). Uses store.GetClickStats. Add go-qrcode dependency to go.mod.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestStats in internal/server: returns 30 entries", "TestQR in internal/server: returns image/png content-type"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "ratelimit",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Rate limiting for auth and link creation",
      "brief": "Middleware or handler logic: max 10 signup/login attempts per minute per client IP (429 on exceed); max 30 new links per hour per user (429 on exceed). Use in-memory counters keyed by IP or user ID with TTL. Apply to POST /api/signup, POST /api/login, POST /api/links. Unit tests verify 11th attempt returns 429.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestRateLimitAuth in internal/server: 11th login in minute returns 429", "TestRateLimitLinks in internal/server: 31st link in hour returns 429"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "frontend",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "React pages: signup, login, my links, link detail, not found",
      "brief": "Add routes in src/App.tsx: /signup, /login, /links (create/list/copy/delete), /links/:slug (bar chart for 30 days, QR code), /* for not found. Use react-router. Pages call API endpoints. Tests use renderAt and mockFetch from src/test/. npm run lint and npm test pass.",
      "directories": ["web/src"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignupPage in web/src: renders form", "TestLinksPage in web/src: renders list"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "integration",
      "role": "integration",
      "title": "Acceptance tests A1-A9 under acceptance/",
      "brief": "Write acceptance tests in acceptance/ using httptest and server.New. A1: signup, login, GET /api/me, logout, /api/me 401. A2: create link, GET /<slug> 302, list shows 1 click. A3: duplicate slug 409, ftp scheme 400. A4: second user delete first's link 404, link still redirects. A5: stats 30 days, today count 2 after two redirects. A6: QR returns decodable PNG. A7: 11th login in minute 429. A8: GET /app/ and /app/links/abc return index with <div id=\"root\">. A9: GET /nope123 returns 404.",
      "directories": ["acceptance"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestA1SignupLoginLogout in acceptance", "TestA2CreateRedirectList in acceptance", "TestA3DuplicateSlugBadScheme in acceptance", "TestA4DeleteOtherUserLink in acceptance", "TestA5StatsThirtyDays in acceptance", "TestA6QRPNG in acceptance", "TestA7RateLimitLogin in acceptance", "TestA8AppPages in acceptance", "TestA9UnknownSlug404 in acceptance"],
      "size": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
```
